name: MySQL / MariaDB
description: Migrate MySQL 8+ / MariaDB databases into PostgreSQL-backed projects: information_schema inspection of tables, columns, indexes, keys, views, triggers, procedures, functions, events, generated columns and charsets; deterministic unsigned-safe type widening; AUTO_INCREMENT sequence-state preservation; read-only sessions; batched keyset extraction. No source mutation.
author: TEMM Nexus (first-party)

ui.setup_instructions: Provide host, port, database, username and password. Use a least-privilege read-only account (SELECT on the schemas to import); the connector additionally opens read-only sessions. UNSIGNED types are widened deterministically so no value can overflow the PostgreSQL target; non-utf8mb4 charsets are flagged for transcoding review.
